tasks.title: Implement writing animation for Mini Calculator title
tasks.description: Change the current title animation to a typewriter/writing effect. Read src/App.tsx to locate the h1 title element and src/App.css to see the current animation styles. Replace or modify the existing animation with a typewriter/writing effect where characters appear one by one from left to right. Consider using CSS animation with steps() function or a combination of width animation with overflow hidden to create the writing effect. After implementing the animation, start the dev server in the background using 'npm run dev', take a screenshot using Playwright to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/writing-animation.png, verify the writing animation displays correctly, then stop the dev server using TaskStop. If any component behavior changes, update related tests in src/App.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Title displays with typewriter/writing animation effect
Characters appear sequentially from left to right
Animation timing is smooth and natural (suggest 2-3 second duration)
Screenshot confirms the animation works correctly
